title: Tenés Empanadas Graciela
tagline: Risk on the original TEG world map: countries, armies, dice, cards and secret missions.
summary: Tenés Empanadas Graciela is the Argentine answer to Risk: Ricardo Quesada's 1996 game, grown by a community of players, artists and translators. Fifty countries on a hand-painted world map are dealt out, each player places armies, attacks with dice, trades country cards and follows a secret mission.

This port follows TEG 0.13.0, the last release of the GTK program: the same map and countries, the same continent bonuses, the same dice, the same four kinds of cards and the same missions. Play against the original's robot, with friends on one computer, or online through the website's rooms; the server rolls the dice and deals the cards there.

original.author: Ricardo Quesada and the TEG contributors

players: 2–6 (on one computer, against the robot, or online)

caveat: The rules, the world map, the cards, the missions and the robot are TEG 0.13.0. The browser menus, the hot-seat mode and online play through this website are new; the original’s GTK window, its translations and its other themes are not part of the port.
